-- Notes:
-- Removed LOWER from natco_code as there is no value in caps
-- Internalemployee filter is always 'no' in whole dataset so removing additional filter

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
         DATE(event_date) AS dt
        ,event_date
        ,session_id
        ,action
        ,lower(page_name) AS page_name
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE event_type = 'event'
        AND {{date}}
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
     -- AND lower(internalemployee) = 'no'
        AND natco_code = 'de'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )
        AND lower(category) = 'tariffchange'
        [[ AND {{natco}} ]]
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{category}})
            OR category = {{category}}
            OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
        )
),
base2 AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc(
            CASE 
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily'   THEN 'day'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly'  THEN 'week'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN 'month'
            END,
            dt
        ) AS period_sort,
        CASE 
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily' THEN
                format_datetime(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    format_datetime(date_trunc('week', dt), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                    ' -Wk',
                    CAST(week_of_year(dt) AS VARCHAR)
                )
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN
                format_datetime(date_trunc('month', dt), 'MMM-yyyy')
        END AS period,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE lower(action) = 'onecheckoutinitiated'                               ) AS onecheckout_initiated,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE page_name = 'checkout/account'        AND action = 'PageView'        ) AS registration_page_optional,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE page_name = 'checkout/personalinfo'   AND action = 'PageView'        ) AS personalinfo_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE page_name = 'checkout/identification' AND action = 'PageView'        ) AS ident_page_optional,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE page_name = 'checkout/appointment'    AND action = 'PageView'        ) AS appointment_page_optional,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE page_name = 'checkout/payment'        AND action = 'PageView'        ) AS payment_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE page_name = 'checkout/consent'        AND action = 'PageView'        ) AS orderreview_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE lower(action) = 'purchasesuccess'                                    ) AS order_placed
    FROM base
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    period,
    onecheckout_initiated,
    ROUND(1.0 * registration_page_optional  / NULLIF(onecheckout_initiated, 0), 3) AS registration_page_optional,
    ROUND(1.0 * personalinfo_page           / NULLIF(onecheckout_initiated, 0), 3) AS personalinfo_page,
    ROUND(1.0 * ident_page_optional         / NULLIF(onecheckout_initiated, 0), 3) AS ident_page_optional,
    ROUND(1.0 * appointment_page_optional   / NULLIF(onecheckout_initiated, 0), 3) AS appointment_page_optional,
    ROUND(1.0 * payment_page                / NULLIF(onecheckout_initiated, 0), 3) AS payment_page,
    ROUND(1.0 * orderreview_page            / NULLIF(onecheckout_initiated, 0), 3) AS orderreview_page,
    ROUND(1.0 * order_placed                / NULLIF(onecheckout_initiated, 0), 3) AS order_placed
FROM base2
ORDER BY period_sort;
